subject: Beta target accounts for Suggestions (Console)
body:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 9:12 AM PST
Subject: Beta target accounts for Suggestions (Console)
Attachments: Suggestions_Beta_Target_Accounts_v3.xlsx

Marissa / Dylan,

To unblock the beta rollout plan (PM-857) + feature-flag enablement, I pulled together a proposed Cohort 1 list + the data readiness gates we should enforce before we flip any orgs on.

Attachment: Suggestions_Beta_Target_Accounts_v3.xlsx (tab 1 = proposed list, tab 2 = readiness checklist)

Proposed Cohort 1 (8–10 orgs):
- Northstar Support (high QPS; strong cost sensitivity; already asking for “actionable savings” UI)
- Arkadia Finance (Dedicated; strict controls; wants clear guardrails + auditability)
- HelioCRM (SaaS; consistent traffic; multiple routes to test sorting/filtering)
- BrightDesk (support automation; heavy streaming usage; good for latency delta sanity checks)
- VectorForge (embeddings-heavy but also chat; can validate we don’t confuse route eligibility)
- CedarLabs (AI-native; fast feedback loop; comfortable with beta UX)
- Orion Retail (spiky traffic; good for batching recommendations + risk labels)
- LatticeWorks (multi-region; helpful for validating region scoping)

I’m intentionally not adding very low-traffic accounts or those with missing cost attribution until we’ve got confidence in the estimator outputs.

Data readiness gates (what I’m proposing we require to avoid “empty/incorrect” experiences):
1) >= 7 days of request telemetry for the target project/route (QPS + latency distributions)
2) Cost attribution present for the route/model (token counts + $/token mapping)
3) Cache metrics present (prefix/KV cache hit rate and/or caching enabled flags)
4) No known telemetry lag/backfill issues in last 48h
5) Permissions: at least one org admin with Optimize access + Console access to view Suggestions

Questions for you both:
- Are the readiness gates too strict for week-6 beta? (We can loosen to 72h, but I worry about noisy estimates.)
- Any red flags on these accounts from Console/SRE side (support burden, known UI sensitivity, etc.)?

If we align today, I’ll update the rollout brief + send the final list to CS for outreach sequencing.

— Aditya
Aditya Rao
Product Lead, Redwood Optimize


---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 10:03 AM PST
Subject: Re: Beta target accounts for Suggestions (Console)

This is helpful, thank you.

Two Console-specific notes:
1) We should require “at least one stable route” per org (not constantly changing model pins / rollouts). Otherwise the list will churn and customers will lose trust.
2) For Arkadia: please double-check they’re OK seeing estimates in the Console without any language implying guaranteed savings. They’re sensitive on anything that looks like a commercial commitment.

Re: strictness: I’m in favor of conservative gates for Cohort 1. We can add a Cohort 2 with looser requirements once we know the estimator + risk labels aren’t confusing.

One tweak to the list: I’d swap out VectorForge (they’re mostly embeddings; might create “why am I seeing nothing?” confusion) and include one more “chat-heavy + caching enabled” org so we validate the caching recommendation path.

Dylan — can you sanity check the 7-day requirement vs what the pipeline actually needs for confidence bands?

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Product Lead, Console & Rollouts


---

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 11:21 AM PST
Subject: Re: Beta target accounts for Suggestions (Console)

+1 to conservative for Cohort 1.

On the data side (based on current implementation plan for ENG-19419 + the compute cadence):
- Minimum we can “technically” run with is ~72 hours, but the confidence intervals get very wide for bursty routes.
- 7 days is a good default for production-ish signals, especially for p95 deltas.
- For spiky accounts (retail), I’d prefer 14 days if available, but I’m OK with 7 days for beta as long as the UI shows “stale_as_of” + we’re clear about assumptions.

Two more operational gates I’d add to avoid support escalations:
- API eligibility: org must be on the new cost attribution schema version (otherwise $ estimates can be off)
- At least one “owner” on the account who will respond to feedback requests (CS point of contact). Otherwise we won’t close the loop.

Re: VectorForge: agree with Marissa. If their chat traffic is small, Suggestions will look empty and we’ll end up debugging “bug vs not eligible.” Better to pick someone clearly chat-heavy.

If you send me the updated list, I can have SRE sanity check for any accounts with recent incident noise.

— Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Engineering Lead, Console & Tooling


---

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 1:08 PM PST
Subject: Re: Beta target accounts for Suggestions (Console)

Got it.

Updates I’ll make:
- Add “stable route” gate (no active rollouts / frequent model pin changes on the primary route)
- Add “cost attribution schema v2” gate (good catch)
- Add “named CS POC / owner” gate
- Swap VectorForge out for a chat-heavy account with caching already enabled

Revised Cohort 1 proposal (assuming these pass the checklist):
- Northstar Support
- Arkadia Finance
- HelioCRM
- BrightDesk
- CedarLabs
- Orion Retail
- LatticeWorks
- (NEW) Papertrail Systems (chat-heavy; caching enabled; historically good at giving structured beta feedback)

I’ll update the spreadsheet and point it at the rollout brief. If you’re OK, I’ll also add a short customer-facing blurb for CS to use:
- “Estimated savings, not a guarantee”
- “Risk is performance/reliability risk, not security risk”
- “You control applying changes (no auto-apply)”

Dylan: once I post the updated tab, I’ll ping you for SRE review.

— Aditya


---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 10, 2026 at 2:37 PM PST
Subject: Re: Beta target accounts for Suggestions (Console)

Approved on my side.

Please make sure the CS blurb includes one line about visibility:
- “Suggestions are scoped to your org/project and require Optimize ‘read’ permissions.”

Once the spreadsheet is updated, I’ll incorporate the cohort + gates into the Console beta launch brief and call out that Cohort 1 is “high-signal telemetry only.”

Thanks.

— Marissa
